hostip.description: Hostname or IP address of the KVM/libvirt hypervisor hosting the VM.

login.description: Username used to authenticate to the hypervisor (SSH or libvirt URI).

password.description: Password for the login user. For security, prefer using 'password_file'.

password_file.description: Absolute path to a file containing the password (e.g., /etc/fence_agents/credentials). Recommended for production.

identity_file.description: Path to SSH private key for key-based authentication. Overrides password if set.

plug.description: Name of the VM (guest domain) to fence. Required for multi-VM setups or non-default naming.

retry.description: Maximum number of attempts to execute the fence action (e.g., off/on).

retry_timeout.description: Maximum total time (in seconds) to wait for a fence action to complete. Overrides retry count when reached.

action_delay.description: Seconds to wait after sending a fence command before checking status or retrying.

use_uri.description: Use direct libvirt URI instead of SSH transport. Requires valid libvirt URI.

uri.description: Libvirt connection URI (e.g., 'qemu+ssh://user@host/system'). Only used if use_uri=1.

options.description: Extra options to pass to fence_virsh (comma-separated). Avoid unless absolutely necessary.
